title: Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships
about: The Association of Commonwealth Universities' Queen Elizabeth Commonwealth Scholarships support study for a two-year master's degree in a low or middle-income Commonwealth country. Applicants apply separately for admission to their chosen university course.
requirements: Applicants must also apply for admission to their chosen university course directly with the university, in addition to the QECS application
